entries.en: Joan—or Johanna as some historians[n]argue—was the pope of Rome, even[n]though women couldn't be priests.

entries.speaker: Mr. Inui

entries.speaker: Mr. Inui

entries.speaker: Mr. Ushimaru

entries.speaker: Mr. Ushimaru
entries.en: That said, who knows when dawn[n]will ever come for this country.

entries.speaker: Mr. Ushimaru
entries.en: ...Speaking of which, did you know the[n]concept of "justice" is different in[n]western culture and eastern culture?

entries.speaker: Mr. Ushimaru
entries.en: If you want everyone to live in harmony,[n]rules are absolutely necessary.

entries.speaker: Mr. Ushimaru
entries.en: ...So anyone who disrupts those rules[n]might just end up like this snake.

entries.speaker: Mr. Ushimaru
entries.en: Eastern culture, on the other hand, views[n]justice more like acting and thinking[n]ethically.

entries.speaker: Mr. Ushimaru
entries.en: This exists in the individual.

entries.speaker: Mr. Ushimaru
entries.en: In other words... All humans have their[n]own sense of justice.

entries.speaker: Mr. Ushimaru
entries.en: It's not an easy way to live, but...

entries.speaker: Mr. Ushimaru
entries.en: I'm sure you will all be fine.
